svg.title: Pundoku — знак P4 «Девять клеток» — favicon 16 px (сплошная)
svg.desc: The same P without gaps for 16 px, where a 1-px gap is noise: stem (3,1,3,14), top bar (3,1,11,3), bowl wall (11,1,3,9), bowl bottom (3,7,11,3) as one outline, counter 5x3 as a hole. No antialiased pixel. Colour #5F6DF2. Generated by design/pd155-icons.mjs.
